{{Current events|year=2019|month=07|day=26|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*The [[United States Department of Justice|U.S. Department of Justice]] approves a $26 billion merger between [[T-Mobile US|T-Mobile]] and [[Sprint Corporation|Sprint]]. If finalized, they will become the third-largest [[mobile network operator]] in the nation. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sprint-corp-m-a-t-mobile/sprint-t-mobile-win-u-s-antitrust-approval-for-26-billion-merger-idUSKCN1UL1UO (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Heavy rains in [[Al Haouz Province]], [[Morocco]], trigger a landslide, resulting in the deaths of 15 people. [https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2019/07/26/world/middleeast/ap-ml-morocco-landslide.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2019/07/279094/landslide-morocco-el-haouz-region/ (Morocco World News)]
*Two people die and more than 17 are injured when an internal balcony collapses at a nightclub in the [[South Korea]]n city of [[Gwangju]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-49136211 (BBC)]
*[[2019 Batanes earthquake]]
**At least nine people are killed and 60 others injured when two earthquakes strike the province of [[Batanes]] in the [[Philippines]]. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1147120/batanes-quake-fatalities-buried-immediately (InquirerNet)]

;Health and environment
*[[Saudi Arabia]] suspends visas for [[Hajj]] pilgrims arriving from the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], amid safety concerns regarding the [[2018–19 Kivu Ebola epidemic|ongoing Ebola epidemic]] in [[Kivu]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/07/saudi-arabia-suspends-visas-people-dr-congo-ebola-190726143929586.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Law and crime
*A man from [[the Bronx]], [[New York City]], is arrested for attempting to join the [[Taliban]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/US/bronx-man-arrested-jfk-airport-allegedly-seeking-join/story?id=64592126 (ABC News)]
*Sixteen [[United States Marine Corps|American Marines]] are arrested at [[Camp Pendleton]], [[California]], on suspicion of aiding human smuggling and drug charges. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/marines-arrested-16-u-s-navy-seals-arrested-at-camp-pendleton-after-human-smuggling-investigation-today-2019-07-25/ (CBS News)]
